cases.case: Numeric factories/accessors preserve large positive/negative integers and exact decimals, reject wrong kinds, and preserve legacy decimal-backed integer classification.
Legacy narrowing rejects overflow and inexact decimals; no rounding or double fallback in the opt-in exact lane.
Digit/scale/output limits reject before oversized parsing/arithmetic/formatting allocations; default limits reject and scale zero succeeds.
Exact payload storage coexists with authenticated evidence, scalar equality/hash, revocation and snapshot lifetime; preserve measured 48-byte layout and inline path.
XQuery producer freezes effective prolog/module context; later compiler mutation cannot alter binding or execution; Evaluate runs inside the actual operation.
XSLT freezes compiler options, static parameters, package closure and selected resolver/resource policy; unsupported mutable capabilities refuse without legacy fallback.
Named-template initial match and global context remain separate, including source-free work, absent-context errors and two distinct admitted snapshots.
Transform rejects foreign/closed operations and unadmitted input/context node graphs; typed values survive raw results without serialize/reparse.
Arbitrary initial item sequences, atomic global context and streaming reject explicitly in this bounded profile; owners decide whether broader signatures are needed before freeze.
All three hosts enforce exact numeric and dynamic-input policies, constructor/assessment dispatch, multi-source lease ordering, cancellation, close/drain and deferred consumption.
